summary: a unified diff (git diff) against the base commit, changing only files under python/sglang/
only source files (.py, .cu, .cuh, .h, .hpp, .c, .cc, .cpp, .json); no renames, mode changes, symlinks, binary patches or empty new files
no added line over 400 characters; at most 400 KB
lossless: no lower precision, approximations or skipped work beyond what stock SGLang does
launch flags: change them in the flags file okc serve init writes, except the ones it lists as fixed
at most 2 GB more GPU memory per GPU than stock SGLang
time to first token at most 2x stock SGLang's at each load
readable source: no compressed, encoded or obfuscated code
written like an SGLang pull request: nothing special-cased to the challenge's workload or load levels, and nothing that breaks other models or GPUs

launch_flags.rules:
- It changes the target model's precision: --dtype, --quantization*, --kv-cache-dtype, --prefill-kv-cache-dequant-dtype, --modelopt-*, --quantize-and-serve, --enable-tf32-matmul, --enable-quant-communications, --deepep-dispatcher-output-dtype, --flashinfer-mxfp4-moe-precision, --quantization-param-path, --enable-w4a4-mxfp4-megamoe, --speculative-enable-w4a4-mxfp4-megamoe, --rl-quant-profile
- It changes the model or makes speculation inexact: --model-path, --revision, --json-model-override-args, --*lora*, --speculative-accept-threshold-*, --speculative-use-rejection-sampling, --watermark-*, --decrypted-config-file, --custom-weight-loader, --model-loader-extra-config, --preferred-sampling-params, --sampling-defaults, --model-impl, --tokenizer-path, --checkpoint-engine-*, --modelexpress-config, --kt-*, --speculative-draft-model-quantization, --speculative-draft-kv-cache-dtype, --speculative-draft-load-format, --speculative-draft-model-revision, --decrypted-draft-config-file, --speculative-token-map, --speculative-ngram-external-corpus-path, --speculative-dspark-*-path
- It truncates prompts: --context-length, --allow-auto-truncate
- It keeps state outside the server or sends data out of the pod: --hicache-storage-*, --*lmcache*, --*flexkv*, --*external-linker*, --weight-cache-*, --remote-instance-*, --otlp-*, --kv-events*, --load-publish-endpoint, --export-metrics-*, --debug-tensor-dump-*, --crash-dump-folder, --log-requests*, --forward-hooks, --encoder-*urls, --decoupled-spec-*endpoint*, --nnodes, --node-rank, --dist-init-addr, --nccl-init-addr, --disaggregation-*, --spec-trace-dir, --file-storage-path
